notes: The user asked for a looping test race track and answered in lap times, so this is Racing on route-circuit rather than a vehicle sim: the space is a closed racing loop, not a persistent world to operate machinery in, and the circuit's P6 is doing real work here because a test loop that does not close is simply broken. Circuit Racing is the matching preset, with spawn-grid swapped for startpoint-line because there is one kart being tuned rather than a field launching side by side; path-turnaround is what the two ends of an oval are. No finish trigger was taken, and that is deliberate — the answer chose an endless loop to drive for feel, so lap detection is the only timing the space needs and there is no round to end. The answer also rules elevation out explicitly, so terrain-relief is not taken and nothing adds tiered: a perfectly flat grey-box oval, with barriers as plain grey kerb walls keeping the kart on the surface.
